main.name: Michael Tanner
main.tagline: Ex-SpaceX, ex-Blue Origin. I like ambitious projects that need someone to define the product, draw the architecture, write the code, and lead the team.
bio: I started in aerospace: supporting launches at SpaceX and assembling, inspecting, and testing BE-4 — the most powerful liquid oxygen / liquid methane rocket engine to date — at Blue Origin. Toward the end of 2018, I was asked to analyze and trend igniter test data, and instead of doing it the usual way I automated the entire process into a one-touch web service. That project pulled me into software for good.

Since then I've built search infrastructure used by public safety agencies worldwide, been the founding engineer at a startup, and most recently shipped Axon Community Request with Amazon Ring as tech lead — taking the project from greenfield design through public launch over five years, delivering a privacy-preserving, auditable, courtroom-ready evidence pipeline.

experience.title: Senior Software Engineer
bullets: Tech lead of the five-engineer team that delivered Axon Community Request with Ring — the publicly announced Axon–Ring partnership that lets verified public safety agencies invite Ring camera owners to securely share video evidence, with full chain of custody preserved into Axon Evidence.

Resurrected a previously paused greenfield project and rolled it out to Ring Neighbors-Verified agencies across the US, owning system design, sprint execution, and code review while partnering with product, legal, and partner engineering & security teams.
Led the team that built AI-Powered Crash Diagramming during Axon's company-wide Gen-AI hackathon — the prototype was selected by Axon's CEO roundtable and voted a top-3 customer favorite at IACP.

Built and shipped the NCIC Store backend for Axon's records-management product; within weeks of launch, 103 Ft. Lauderdale PD officers had completed 600+ imports (~45/day), with five more Florida agencies in UAT.

experience.title: Software Engineer II
bullets: Co-owned search and indexing for Axon Evidence, the digital evidence management system used by public safety agencies worldwide, across 9 production Solr clusters spanning US, EU, and government/regulated environments.

Migrated production search infrastructure to Solr 8 / Java 11 with remote-collection joins, personally rolling out 3 of 9 clusters — including the largest — and rebuilding the migration tooling to handle simultaneous version-and-topology changes.
Shipped Lucene's unified highlighter to production and migrated transcript search, cutting per-query latency ~4× (≈2s to ≈0.5s) with no regressions.
Led after-action reviews for production incidents, partnering with SRE, infrastructure, and engineering executives on root cause.

experience.title: Founding Engineer
bullets: Founding technical staff at a Seattle-based startup building ephemeral, ready-to-code, on-demand cloud developer environments.
Designed and shipped end-to-end features in Go across the platform during the company's earliest months.

experience.title: Software Engineer II
bullets: Lead engineer on the greenfield design of what shipped publicly in 2025 as Axon Community Request with Ring — owned product definition, system architecture, and detailed design for a new way for police to collect digital evidence from communities.
Defined the chain-of-custody model, geo-targeted request flow, and voluntary-share/anonymous-decline pattern that became the foundation of the shipped product.
Partnered with product, legal, and security stakeholders to scope a system that handles community-sourced digital evidence at scale while preserving resident privacy and auditability.

experience.title: Software Engineer
bullets: Cut 6,000 engineering-hours per year by building a web service for time-series analysis of engine test data — Python and MongoDB back end, Flask front end, hosted on Kubernetes with GitLab CI.
Reduced data processing time from 210 to 20 minutes for 1,000+ test sessions by leveraging multiprocessing.

Slashed the cost of searching engineering drawings by 80% using Terraform, GitLab CI, Python, AWS Lambda, API Gateway, and Kubernetes; cut business-intelligence extract endpoint costs by 99% with Java and Spring Boot on AWS.
Halved post-test visual inspection time by writing Python to operate a custom-built robotic inspection tool.

experience.title: Propulsion Engineer
bullets: Assembled, inspected, troubleshot, and conducted tests on BE-4, the most powerful liquid oxygen / liquid methane rocket engine to date.
Developed a valve manifold for the BE-4 ignition system — CAD and GD&T drawings in Creo, manufacturing by exotic-metal 3D printing and traditional machining.
Introduced semi-automated inspection tracking that enabled the first-ever two BE-4 tests in a single day.

experience.title: Associate Launch Engineer
bullets: Predicted and analyzed inter-stage purge heat exchanger performance across launch sites using heat transfer models.
Planned, procured, and installed secondary cooling supply water for helium hydropacs.

earlier.note: Designed, fabricated, and analyzed a sub-scale bi-propellant test stand for hypergolic combustor research at Purdue.
Final-assembly integration for the bi-propellant throttle valve in Hawthorne, CA — cut test stand downtime in one case by 5 days.
Designed, fabricated, and activated a warming purge system for Merlin engine test stands in McGregor, TX.
Takt time simulations for body shop planning in Sindelfingen, Germany.
Statistical gauge analysis and downtime tooling in Vance, AL.
